units.source_text: 据说，人间凋谢的花的芳香，升上了天堂，这种芳香在天堂也绽开了和人间一样的花。

en.t: It is said that the fragrance of flowers that wither in the human world rises to heaven, and there that fragrance blooms into the same flowers as those on earth.

units.source_text: 因为天国的物质都是人间上升的香气凝成的。

en.t: For all the substance of heaven is formed from fragrances that have risen from the human world.

units.source_text: 只要仔细观察就会发现：人间死亡了的东西，腐烂了的东西，都有自己的香气。

en.t: If one observes carefully, one discovers that things that have died in the human world, things that have decayed, all have their own fragrance.

units.source_text: 它们在成为香气之前，本来也是由香气凝成的。

en.t: Before they became fragrance, they too were originally formed from fragrance.

units.source_text: 洋槐的芳香和竹子的清香不同。

en.t: The fragrance of acacia is different from the clear scent of bamboo.

units.source_text: 腐烂了的麻的香气和腐烂了的罗纱的香气也不一样。

en.t: The smell of rotted hemp and the smell of rotted woolen cloth are different as well.
